definition.name: Set Site Elevation At Zero Level
definition.description: Sets the shared elevation at internal Z=0 of a named project location (site) to a target value in metres, keeping angle and E/W, N/S unchanged.
definition.aiDescription: Sets the shared elevation at internal Z=0 of a named project location (site) to a target value in metres, keeping angle and E/W, N/S unchanged.
examples: set the zero level elevation of a named site to 3.5 m
definition.author: mrafaatFK2S3
